raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On Intel XPU (CRI), diffusion self-attention runs BF16 flash attention and dominates video DiT steps. deepklox's SageAttention V3 kernels for CRI are 2-2.6x faster at these shapes but are not usable from sglang.

## Modifications

Opt-in `SGLANG_DIFFUSION_XPU_SAGE_ATTN_V3=pure|hybrid` in the XPU attention backend: eligible self-attention layers run deepklox SageAttention V3; everything else, plus blocks listed in `SGLANG_DIFFUSION_XPU_SAGE_ATTN_V3_BF16_BLOCKS`, keeps BF16 flash attention. The kernel is a torch custom op, so `torch.compile` has no graph break.

## Accuracy Tests

Wan2.2-T2V-A14B 1280x720x81, 40 steps, BF16 blocks 0,33,34,38: valid video with the same scene and motion as BF16 (PSNR 16.7 dB). Kernel vs fp32 at Wan shape: cosine 0.962 (`pure`), 0.985 (`hybrid`).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

1 Intel CRI card. Self-attention S=75600, H=40, D=128: flash 555.3 ms, `pure` 215.1 ms (2.58x), `hybrid` 268.8 ms (2.07x). Wan2.2-T2V-A14B 1280x720x81, 40 steps, end to end: 2398.8 s -> 1411.9 s (1.70x).

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

 # Copied and adapted from: https://github.com/hao-ai-lab/FastVideo
 
 # SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+import math
+import re
 from functools import lru_cache
 
 import torch
 
+from sglang.multimodal_gen import envs
 from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.platforms import AttentionBackendEnum
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.utils.logging_utils import init_logger
 
 try:

+try:
+    from deepklox.sageattn_interface import sageattn_v3, sageattn_v3_hybrid
+except ImportError:
+    sageattn_v3 = sageattn_v3_hybrid = None
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+_SAGE_V3_KINDS = ("pure", "hybrid")
+_BLOCK_INDEX_RE = re.compile(r"(?:^|\.)blocks\.(\d+)\.")
+
+
+@torch.library.custom_op("sglang::xpu_sage_v3_attn", mutates_args=())
+def _xpu_sage_v3_attn(
+    query: torch.Tensor, key: torch.Tensor, value: torch.Tensor, kind: str
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    attn = sageattn_v3 if kind == "pure" else sageattn_v3_hybrid
+    return attn(query, key, value, tensor_layout="NHD")
+
+
+@_xpu_sage_v3_attn.register_fake
+def _(
+    query: torch.Tensor, key: torch.Tensor, value: torch.Tensor, kind: str
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    return torch.empty(query.shape, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=query.device)
+
+
+def _resolve_sage_v3_kind(
+    *,
+    prefix: str,
+    head_size: int,
+    num_heads: int,
+    num_kv_heads: int | None,
+    softmax_scale: float,
+    causal: bool,
+    is_cross_attention: bool,
+) -> str | None:
+    kind = envs.SGLANG_DIFFUSION_XPU_SAGE_ATTN_V3.strip().lower()
+    if not kind:
+        return None
+    if kind not in _SAGE_V3_KINDS:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"SGLANG_DIFFUSION_XPU_SAGE_ATTN_V3 must be one of {_SAGE_V3_KINDS}, got {kind!r}"
+        )
+    if sageattn_v3 is None:
+        raise ImportError(
+            "SGLANG_DIFFUSION_XPU_SAGE_ATTN_V3 needs deepklox built with SageAttention V3 (CRI)"
+        )
+    if (
+        causal
+        or is_cross_attention
+        or head_size != 128
+        or (num_kv_heads is not None and num_kv_heads != num_heads)
+        or not math.isclose(softmax_scale, head_size**-0.5, rel_tol=1e-6)
+    ):
+        return None
+    bf16_blocks = {
+        int(b)
+        for b in envs.SGLANG_DIFFUSION_XPU_SAGE_ATTN_V3_BF16_BLOCKS.split(",")
+        if b.strip()
+    }
+    block = _BLOCK_INDEX_RE.search(prefix)
+    if block is not None and int(block.group(1)) in bf16_blocks:
+        return None
+    logger.info_once(
+        f"Using deepklox SageAttention V3 ({kind}) for XPU self-attention; "
+        f"BF16 flash attention for blocks {sorted(bf16_blocks)} and cross-attention."
+    )
+    return kind
+

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""deepklox SageAttention V3 path of the XPU attention backend against its BF16 flash attention.
+
+Needs an Intel XPU with deepklox built with SageAttention V3 (CRI / Xe3P); skipped elsewhere.
+"""
+
+import importlib.util
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not (hasattr(torch, "xpu") and torch.xpu.is_available())
+    or importlib.util.find_spec("deepklox") is None,
+    reason="SageAttention V3 needs an Intel XPU with deepklox",
+)
+
+HEADS = 8
+HEAD_DIM = 128
+SOFTMAX_SCALE = HEAD_DIM**-0.5
+
+
+def _make_impl(
+    monkeypatch, kind, *, prefix="blocks.1.attn1.impl", bf16_blocks="", **kwargs
+):
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.attention.backends.xpu_backend import (
+        XPUAttentionImpl,
+    )
+
+    if kind is None:
+        monkeypatch.delenv("SGLANG_DIFFUSION_XPU_SAGE_ATTN_V3", raising=False)
+    else:
+        monkeypatch.setenv("SGLANG_DIFFUSION_XPU_SAGE_ATTN_V3", kind)
+    monkeypatch.setenv("SGLANG_DIFFUSION_XPU_SAGE_ATTN_V3_BF16_BLOCKS", bf16_blocks)
+    options = {
+        "num_heads": HEADS,
+        "head_size": HEAD_DIM,
+        "causal": False,
+        "softmax_scale": SOFTMAX_SCALE,
+        "prefix": prefix,
+        **kwargs,
+    }
+    return XPUAttentionImpl(**options)
+
+
+def _fused_qkv_views(sequence, seed=0):
+    generator = torch.Generator(device="xpu").manual_seed(seed)
+    qkv = torch.randn(
+        (sequence, 3 * HEADS * HEAD_DIM),
+        device="xpu",
+        dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        generator=generator,
+    )
+    q, k, v = (t.view(1, sequence, HEADS, HEAD_DIM) for t in qkv.chunk(3, dim=-1))
+    return q, k, v
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind, min_cosine", [("pure", 0.95), ("hybrid", 0.98)])
+def test_forward_tracks_flash_attention(monkeypatch, kind, min_cosine):
+    flash = _make_impl(monkeypatch, None)
+    ours = _make_impl(monkeypatch, kind)
+    q, k, v = _fused_qkv_views(4096)
+
+    output = ours.forward(q, k, v)
+    expected = flash.forward(q, k, v)
+
+    assert output.shape == expected.shape
+    assert output.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+    assert torch.isfinite(output.float()).all()
+    assert not torch.equal(output, expected)
+    cosine = torch.nn.functional.cosine_similarity(
+        output.float().flatten(), expected.float().flatten(), dim=0
+    ).item()
+    assert cosine > min_cosine, cosine
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "kwargs",
+    [
+        {"prefix": "blocks.33.attn1.impl", "bf16_blocks": "0,33"},
+        {"is_cross_attention": True},
+        {"causal": True},
+        {"num_kv_heads": HEADS // 2},
+    ],
+    ids=["bf16_block", "cross_attention", "causal", "gqa"],
+)
+def test_ineligible_layer_falls_back_to_flash_attention(monkeypatch, kwargs):
+    flash = _make_impl(monkeypatch, None, **kwargs)
+    ours = _make_impl(monkeypatch, "pure", **kwargs)
+    q, k, v = _fused_qkv_views(1024, seed=1)
+
+    assert torch.equal(ours.forward(q, k, v), flash.forward(q, k, v))
+
+
+def test_bf16_block_list_matches_whole_indices(monkeypatch):
+    flash = _make_impl(monkeypatch, None)
+    ours = _make_impl(
+        monkeypatch, "pure", prefix="blocks.330.attn1.impl", bf16_blocks="33"
+    )
+    q, k, v = _fused_qkv_views(1024, seed=2)
+
+    assert not torch.equal(ours.forward(q, k, v), flash.forward(q, k, v))
+
+
+def test_unknown_kind_is_rejected(monkeypatch):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="SGLANG_DIFFUSION_XPU_SAGE_ATTN_V3"):
+        _make_impl(monkeypatch, "fp8")
+
+
+def test_compiles_without_graph_breaks(monkeypatch):
+    ours = _make_impl(monkeypatch, "pure")
+    q, k, v = _fused_qkv_views(1024, seed=3)
+
+    explanation = torch._dynamo.explain(ours.forward)(q, k, v)
+
+    assert explanation.graph_break_count == 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import sys
+
+    sys.exit(pytest.main([__file__, "-v"]))
